observations: Single circular rubber-and-metal component, viewed face-on.
Black rubber flexible section bonded to a metal hub with six bolt holes, each with a bolt and nut visible.
Markings on the metal hub read 'F80' at top and 'F80H 2012' with additional partly legible code below.
Watermark across the image reads 'ADUANYA ENTERPRISE'.
Surface shows dust and some wear, no visible cracks but rubber texture not fully shown from this single angle.
No scale reference, no close-up of bore/shaft hole, no view of the rubber's condition from the side.

claims.claim: Minimize downtime and protect your drivetrain with the Fenaflex F80 Tyre
claims.evidence: Marketing language, no way to verify performance or protective function from a photo.
Photo 0 shows a used-looking, dusty component with visible bolts; no proof of new condition or functional integrity.

risks.risk: Rubber element could be cracked, perished, or delaminated from the hub, which would make it unusable.
risks.proof: Close-up side and underside photos of the full rubber tyre section showing no cracks or separation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn/possibly compromised rubber, not as new/intact

risks.risk: Bore diameter and bolt circle may not match buyer's shaft/flange, since only the face is shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the bore hole with a ruler or caliper, and a side profile shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified fitment, buyer assumes compatibility risk

risks.risk: Date code 'F80H 2012' may indicate old manufacture date, meaning rubber may have degraded with age even if unused.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the full date/batch code for verification.
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock, not as recently manufactured

risks.risk: Used vs new status unclear; bolts and nuts look installed/used rather than factory-packaged.
risks.proof: Photo of original packaging or box, or confirmation shot showing unused bolt threads.

proof_requests: Close-up of the full rubber tyre body (side view) showing no cracks or wear.
Photo of the bore hole with a measuring tape or caliper for size confirmation.
Clear, legible photo of the full date/batch code on the hub.
Photo showing original packaging or invoice if claimed new.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by brand and model (Fenaflex F80) from the visible markings, but condition, rubber integrity, and fitment are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as a used coupling of unconfirmed condition.
